plan.title: Annual Donation Summary
plan.subtitle: Overview of donation volume, value, and trends for the current year

panels.title: Total Donations Received
panels.sql: SELECT SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE CONCAT(STRFTIME(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y'), '%')

panels.title: Number of Transactions
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE CONCAT(STRFTIME(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y'), '%')

panels.title: Average Donation Size
panels.sql: SELECT AVG("Amount") AS avg_amount FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE CONCAT(STRFTIME(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y'), '%')

panels.title: Monthly Donation Trend
panels.sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CAST("Date" AS DATE)) AS month, SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE CONCAT(STRFTIME(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y'), '%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Donations by Payment Mode
panels.sql: SELECT "Mode", SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE CONCAT(STRFTIME(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y'), '%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Top 5 Cities by Donation Value
panels.sql: SELECT "City", SUM("Amount") AS total_amount FROM "donor_transactions" WHERE "Date" LIKE CONCAT(STRFTIME(CURRENT_DATE, '%Y'), '%') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 5
